decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting assertions regarding Tesla's Q3 2019 revenue. Document D1 (and card d1:c0) explicitly states the revenue was '$6.3 billion', while Document D2 (and card d2:c0) states it was '$1.30 billion'. Both sources reference the same entity (Tesla), the same time period (Q3 2019), and the same metric (revenue). Per the instruction to preserve separately valid referents and complementary answers where competing assertions exist without resolving them as errors, both values are included as they are directly supported by the supplied source text.
